newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank poll - no change seen this week.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank poll - no change seen this week.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Wednesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank change its leading interest rates this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 1
No 9
3. Will there be a rise in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
4. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3. 4.
Mathias Haffner, BZW, Frankfurt No No No Yes
Steven King, James Capel, London No No No Yes
Steven Hannah, IBJ Int. London No No No Yes
Charles Yeo, Nat West Bank, London No Yes No Yes
Alison Cottrell, Paine Webber, London No No No Yes
Sonja Gibbs, Nomura Int. London No No No Yes
Thomas Mayer, Goldman Sachs, Ffm No No No Yes
Jrg Krmer, Merrill Lynch, Frankfurt No No No Yes
Jrgen Graf, SGZ Bank, Frankfurt No No No Yes
